summary: Independent non-author High-Signal Blocking PR Review of final ADR 0034 integration PR #186 (commit 049cc13b129223239cf987590a70c1394e035524, tree 4aaeb468ec21fb40aae00776e75c4032e47052e8) relative to base main (commit 8dd99b80470d5bdde203556b88c778332f9e92fb, tree f3672ddaecba7b9e25ce6a326d7d305b55960e8b). Verified CI receipt parsing, digest matching, atomic zip publication, fail-closed runner exit codes, multiset node reconciliation, inherited failure classification, scheduler concurrency, and ADR compliance. Identified 1 blocking P1 issue in tests/packaging/test_p1_distribution.py where shared build_once caching reuses pre-built artifacts without input tree binding, bypassing critical sdist attack refusal verification in test_sdist_hardening.py.

comments.title: Shared packaging build cache bypasses sdist attack refusal verification
comments.failure_scenario: When tests/packaging/test_p1_distribution.py executes in the same test session before tests/packaging/test_sdist_hardening.py, the shared base / 'package-distributions' directory and ready.json receipt are already populated from the real repository build. When test_sdist_hardening.py::test_distribution_gate_refuses_before_extract_rebuild_or_install subsequently invokes p1_distributions.__wrapped__(tmp_path_factory) with monkeypatched ROOT (source specimen) and runner (fake_build), build_once reuses the existing cached legitimate build instead of executing the build with the attack specimen. Consequently, check_sdist is never invoked on the malicious sdist, no ValueError is raised, and test_distribution_gate_refuses_before_extract_rebuild_or_install fails with 'Failed: DID NOT RAISE ValueError', causing the packaging test suite to exit with code 1 and bypassing critical security gate verification.
comments.evidence: In tests/packaging/test_p1_distribution.py line 45, build_once is called with base / 'package-distributions' without binding to ROOT or input tree fingerprint. On main, p1_distributions used tmp_path_factory.mktemp('p1-packages'), creating an isolated directory for every invocation. Running `pytest tests/packaging/test_p1_distribution.py tests/packaging/test_sdist_hardening.py` succeeds on main (96 passed) but fails on HEAD (1 failed, 95 passed) with 'Failed: DID NOT RAISE ValueError'. This directly contradicts ADR 0034 requirement that shared artifacts are built 'exactly once per unique input tree fingerprint'.
comments.recommended_fix: In tests/packaging/test_p1_distribution.py, bind the build_once directory path to the resolved ROOT path or input tree fingerprint (e.g. `base / f'package-distributions-{hashlib.sha256(str(ROOT.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]}'` or use an isolated temporary directory when ROOT is overridden), ensuring that alternative or specimen source trees execute an independent build rather than reusing the real checkout's cached build.

rule_references.section: Decision & Context (Item 4: Shared immutable build outputs)
rule_references.requirement: Artifacts (direct wheel, sdist, sdist-derived wheel, and locked wheelhouse) are built exactly once per unique input tree fingerprint and sealed with SHA-256 receipts protected by file locking.
rule_references.conflict: tests/packaging/test_p1_distribution.py hardcodes base / 'package-distributions' without binding to the input tree fingerprint or ROOT, causing builds to be reused across different source trees and bypassing attack specimen rejection in test_sdist_hardening.py.
